capabilities: Sync the vault via native Git on desktop (Windows/Mac/Linux)
Sync via GitHub, GitLab, or Gitea REST APIs on mobile
Store Personal Access Tokens locally in Obsidian's secure storage
Track updates to reduce file overwrites during multi-device editing
extras: Listing description carries the note "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." The README asks users to report bugs via Issues/Discussions as the plugin is newly released.
motivation: The README says syncing a vault with Git across operating systems usually requires different strategies per platform; the author built an adaptive engine to bridge that gap.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in cross-device Git sync, and mobile OS limitations prevent running a local Git binary on phones.

requires.name: Personal Access Token with repo read/write scopes (mobile)

summary: Cross-platform Git sync plugin that runs native Git on desktop and Git provider REST APIs (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea) on mobile.
